title: Use of externally-controlled format string in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a nearby administrator to read or write memory, potentially resulting in a denial-of-service…
desc:
Use of externally-controlled format string in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a nearby administrator to read or write memory, potentially resulting in a denial-of-service, via crafted format specifiers sent to the logging/summary function.
Refer to the ' Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

title: Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a remote attacker to obtain router’s UID or login authorization tokens for the victim's…
desc:
Insertion of sensitive information into sent data in certain ASUS Router firmware allows a remote attacker to obtain router’s UID or login authorization tokens for the victim's linked account via a crafted web page, which requires a logged-in router administrator to actively complete the third-party authorization flow.
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Router Firmware ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

title: Netgate pfSense CE XMLRPC Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability.
desc:
Netgate pfSense CE XMLRPC Incorrect Authorization Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Netgate pfSense. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the XMLRPC endpoint. The issue results from incorrect authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code within the context of the root. Was ZDI-CAN-32353.

title: Vulnerability in the Oracle WebCenter Content product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Content Portal Suite).
desc: Vulnerability in the Oracle WebCenter Content product of Oracle Fusion Middleware (component: Content Portal Suite).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.1.4.0 and  14.1.2.0.0. Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle WebCenter Content accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 3.1 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N).

title: fqterm 0.9.9 before 0.9.11 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in its SSH client that trusts unchecked server-supplied length fields for allocations, copies and…
desc: fqterm 0.9.9 before 0.9.11 contains an out-of-bounds memory access vulnerability in its SSH client that trusts unchecked server-supplied length fields for allocations, copies and read positions. Malicious servers or man-in-the-middle attackers can send crafted lengths in getString(), KEXINIT name-lists, key parsing or packet framing before host key verification to crash the client.

title: fqterm before 0.9.11 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FQTermDecode that allows malicious servers to corrupt memory by sending CSI sequences with unbounded…
desc: fqterm before 0.9.11 contains a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in FQTermDecode that allows malicious servers to corrupt memory by sending CSI sequences with unbounded parameter indexes. Attackers controlling a telnet or SSH server, or intercepting cleartext telnet, can send over 30 semicolon-separated CSI parameters to write chosen 32-bit values past the decoder object on the heap.

title: Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadString() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c that fails to handle…
desc: Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadString() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c that fails to handle end of file. Attackers can supply an empty, truncated, or crafted .plus game file that hangs Gargoyle at full CPU until the user kills it.

title: Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadAction() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c, which…
desc: Gargoyle 2023.1 through 2026.1.1 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the bundled Plus interpreter's ReadAction() function in terps/plus/loaddatabase.c, which never bounds-checks the index into the 1024-entry conditions array. Attackers can supply a crafted or truncated .plus game file with unterminated action conditions to write file-controlled values past the array and crash the player.

title: SOIL2 before 1.4.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in its DDS, PVR and PKM image loaders that write results through unchecked caller-supplied output pointers.
desc: SOIL2 before 1.4.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in its DDS, PVR and PKM image loaders that write results through unchecked caller-supplied output pointers. Attackers can supply a valid DDS, PVR or PKM file to applications passing NULL output pointers to SOIL_load_image or stbi_info, causing a crash.

title: WLA DX 9.7 through 10.7 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in parse_data_blocks() in wlalink/analyze.c that copies section namespaces without length checks.
desc: WLA DX 9.7 through 10.7 contains a stack-based buffer overflow vulnerability in parse_data_blocks() in wlalink/analyze.c that copies section namespaces without length checks. Attackers can supply a crafted object or library file with a namespace longer than 255 bytes or unterminated to overflow the 256-byte stack buffer when linked.

title: Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in stdio-to-SSE mode that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the gateway via…
desc: Supergateway 4.2.0 through 4.2.2 contains a denial of service vulnerability in stdio-to-SSE mode that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the gateway via prototype-inherited sessionId values. Attackers can send a POST message request with sessionId set to toString or constructor, triggering an unhandled TypeError that terminates every attached MCP session.

title: Pika before 1.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource allocation vulnerability that allows malicious brokers to exhaust client memory by declaring oversized frame payloads.
desc: Pika before 1.5.0 contains an uncontrolled resource allocation vulnerability that allows malicious brokers to exhaust client memory by declaring oversized frame payloads. Attackers can send frame headers declaring up to 4 GiB payloads, unchecked against frame_max, or very large message bodies to terminate consuming applications.

title: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_vnc() in src/dissectors/ec_vnc.c that checks total packet length instead of remaining bytes.
desc: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_vnc() in src/dissectors/ec_vnc.c that checks total packet length instead of remaining bytes. A malicious VNC server can send the authentication type and challenge in one short packet to leak up to 3 bytes of adjacent heap memory via the logged challenge.

title: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds…
desc: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_mysql() in src/dissectors/ec_mysql.c that copies seed and password bytes without bounds checks. A malicious MySQL server or client can send truncated greeting or login packets to leak adjacent heap memory through hex-encoded output in the interface and log.

title: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_ssh() in src/dissectors/ec_ssh.c that copies a peer-supplied data_len without checking…
desc: Ettercap through 0.8.5.1 contains a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in dissector_ssh() in src/dissectors/ec_ssh.c that copies a peer-supplied data_len without checking remaining packet bytes. A malicious SSHv1 client or server in an intercepted session can send a short packet with a large data_len to disclose up to 64 bytes of adjacent heap memory through captured credentials in the interface and log.

title: OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 contains a format string vulnerability in json_response() and related output functions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code by…
desc: OwnTracks Recorder before 1.0.5 contains a format string vulnerability in json_response() and related output functions that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute code by storing a malicious tid value. Attackers can publish locations via POST /pub or MQTT with printf specifiers in tid, then read them back through GET /api/0/last to leak addresses and write memory.

title: ILIAS before 9.25, 10.13, and 11.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in ilPRGAssignmentFilter::toConditions() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through the…
desc: ILIAS before 9.25, 10.13, and 11.6 contains an SQL injection vulnerability in ilPRGAssignmentFilter::toConditions() that allows authenticated users to inject SQL through the StudyProgramme members list Name and Status filters. Attackers holding only the OrgUnit permission to view members can break out of LIKE literals and execute stacked statements, such as overwriting the root password hash to gain administrative control.

title: ILIAS 11.0 before 11.6 contains an sql injection vulnerability in RegistrationCodeRepository::getCodesData() that concatenates unvalidated sort fields into an ORDER BY clause.
desc: ILIAS 11.0 before 11.6 contains an sql injection vulnerability in RegistrationCodeRepository::getCodesData() that concatenates unvalidated sort fields into an ORDER BY clause. Authenticated users with read access to the Authentication and Registration administration node can supply SQL expressions as the sort parameter to extract database contents via boolean-based inference.

title: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL() that allows malicious PLCs to overwrite client memory by sending oversized multi-slice…
desc: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadSZL() that allows malicious PLCs to overwrite client memory by sending oversized multi-slice SZL responses. A rogue or impersonated PLC can keep flagging more data with attacker-controlled DLen slices, overflowing the 65536-byte opData buffer via Cli_ReadSZL() and Cli_ReadSZLList(), crashing the client and corrupting heap memory.

title: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars() that allows malicious PLCs to overflow client buffers via unchecked…
desc: Snap7 through 1.4.3 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in TSnap7MicroClient::opReadMultiVars() that allows malicious PLCs to overflow client buffers via unchecked DataLength fields. Attackers controlling or impersonating a PLC can return crafted ReadVar responses to Cli_ReadMultiVars() callers, writing up to 65535 bytes per item to corrupt memory and crash clients.

title: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in NSSCryptoSignBackend.cc that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed CMS arena memory during repeated…
desc: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in NSSCryptoSignBackend.cc that allows attackers to trigger reads of freed CMS arena memory during repeated signature verification. Attackers can supply a signed PDF embedding the signer certificate to crash applications or pdfsig runs validating multiple signatures, or cause incorrect certificate validation results.

title: Poppler 0.76.1 through 26.11.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SplashOutputDev::iccTransform() that allows attackers to write out of bounds when rendering in…
desc: Poppler 0.76.1 through 26.11.0 contains a heap-based buffer overflow in SplashOutputDev::iccTransform() that allows attackers to write out of bounds when rendering in splashModeDeviceN8. Attackers can supply a PDF with an ICCBased image whose alternate is DeviceN, causing getDeviceNLine() to overflow the per-row buffer, crashing the renderer and corrupting heap memory.

title: Poppler 21.01.0 through 26.11.0 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in FormWidgetSignature::signDocument() that allows local attackers to obtain valid signatures…
desc: Poppler 21.01.0 through 26.11.0 contains a time-of-check time-of-use race condition in FormWidgetSignature::signDocument() that allows local attackers to obtain valid signatures over altered content. Attackers with write access to the output file or directory can overwrite or swap the PDF between writing and hashing, causing the signer's key to sign attacker-controlled content.

title: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in the libcurl-based remote file loader that trusts unvalidated HEAD Content-Length values in…
desc: Poppler through 26.11.0 contains an uncontrolled memory allocation vulnerability in the libcurl-based remote file loader that trusts unvalidated HEAD Content-Length values in CurlCachedFileLoader::init(). Malicious HTTP servers can return an enormous Content-Length so CachedFile resizes its chunk cache accordingly, aborting pdfinfo or PDFDocFactory-based applications with std::bad_alloc for denial of service.

title: Poppler pdftohtml through 26.11.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in HtmlLink::getLinkStart() in utils/HtmlLinks.cc that writes PDF link annotation URIs into href…
desc: Poppler pdftohtml through 26.11.0 contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability in HtmlLink::getLinkStart() in utils/HtmlLinks.cc that writes PDF link annotation URIs into href attributes without escaping in HTML output modes. Attackers can craft a PDF whose /URI entry contains a double quote followed by HTML markup or event handlers to execute script in browsers viewing the generated HTML.

title: Poppler pdfdetach 24.03.0 through 26.11.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in utils/pdfdetach.cc that allows attackers to write files outside the output directory by…
desc: Poppler pdfdetach 24.03.0 through 26.11.0 contains a path traversal vulnerability in utils/pdfdetach.cc that allows attackers to write files outside the output directory by bypassing a string-prefix containment check. Attackers can craft PDFs with embedded file names containing '..' sequences or absolute paths, so -saveall or -savefile extraction creates or overwrites files with the invoking user's privileges.

title: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated user with repository write access to send requests to internal services through…
desc: A server-side request forgery vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated user with repository write access to send requests to internal services through Slack webhook validity checks, potentially leading to remote code execution on the appliance. Exploitation required Secret Protection with secret scanning and validity checks for partner patterns enabled. This vulnerability affected all versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, and 3.20.12. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

title: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an organization member with permission to manage custom-property definitions…
desc: A stored cross-site scripting vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an organization member with permission to manage custom-property definitions and edit property values to add an attacker-controlled SSH authentication key to the personal account of another member through HTML stored in a single-select custom-property option. Exploitation required another definition manager in the same organization to attempt to remove the poisoned option while it was in use and save the definition with a valid sudo session. Repository access through the added key depended on the permissions of the victim and independent authorization controls. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. title: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl allow code injection via a fetched list line that closes the built-in data heredoc when update_self_from_url…
desc:
IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl allow code injection via a fetched list line that closes the built-in data heredoc when update_self_from_url rewrites the module's source.

The rewrite copies the module's source down to the built-in list's heredoc and appends each fetched line below it. Nothing checks that a line looks like a domain. A line that is not a comment loses only what follows a `//` and its trailing whitespace, so a line reading END_BUILTIN_DATA is appended as it stands and ends the data block in the rewritten file. Every fetched line after it is Perl.

Arbitrary Perl runs in every process that loads IO::Socket::SSL, which loads this module unconditionally, until the file is reinstalled. The attacker must control the fetched list, through the cleartext default URL or a caller-supplied one, and the updater must run with write access to the installed module.

title: IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl let an on-path attacker choose the installed public suffix list because update_self_from_url fetches it over…
desc:
IO::Socket::SSL::PublicSuffix versions through 2.099 for Perl let an on-path attacker choose the installed public suffix list because update_self_from_url fetches it over cleartext HTTP with no integrity check.

Called with no argument, as the module's documentation shows, the updater fetches the list from the `http://` address in the URL constant and checks only that the request succeeded, with no signature or digest over the response. The lines that come back are written into the module's own source file as the built-in list.

An attacker on the network path when the updater runs chooses the suffix boundary the module reports to every caller on the host, and that answer persists in the installed module until it is reinstalled. Dropping one rule makes the hostname check in IO::Socket::SSL accept a wildcard certificate that spans the whole public suffix that rule named.

title: Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character vulnerability in the AdoNetAppender of Apache log4net.
desc:
Improper Neutralization of Null Byte or NUL Character vulnerability in the AdoNetAppender of Apache log4net.

Text parameters were bound unchanged, so a NUL character or an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate reached the database as it was. A database that refuses such a value, such as PostgreSQL, rejected the insert and the event was lost; only the first such loss per appender was reported. A party whose data reaches a log message could suppress that event.

This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

title: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the FileAppender, RollingFileAppender, UdpAppender and SmtpAppender of Apache log4net.
desc:
Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the FileAppender, RollingFileAppender, UdpAppender and SmtpAppender of Apache log4net.

Characters the configured encoding could not represent were converted by that encoding's best-fit fallback, which turns fullwidth characters such as U+FF1C, U+FF1E and U+FF02 into <, > and ". The conversion happened after XmlLayout or XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J had escaped the text, so a party whose data reaches a log message could forge complete log events in an XML log, for example a fake audit entry. On .NET Framework this needs no configuration where the ANSI code page is single-byte, since that is the default encoding; on .NET it needs a configured single-byte encoding such as ISO-8859-1. This is the best-fit conversion described by the WorstFit research.

This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

title: Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the XmlLayout and XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J of Apache log4net.
desc:
Improper Output Neutralization for Logs vulnerability in the XmlLayout and XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J of Apache log4net.

Both layouts split a message holding the CDATA end marker into several CDATA sections, but searched for the marker with a culture-sensitive comparison. Ignorable characters or a combining mark around the marker made the search miss it, so the CDATA section stayed open. From 3.3.1 on, an XML parser then reads the following log events as part of that message; earlier versions leave the log file not well-formed. A party whose data reaches a log message could hide later log events from a consumer that parses the XML log.

This issue affects Apache log4net: from 1.2.9 before 3.6.0.

Users are recommended to upgrade to version 3.6.0, which fixes the issue.

title: Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Observable Discrepancy Information Disclosure Vulnerability.
desc:
Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Observable Discrepancy Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Authentication service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When processing crafted pairing requests, the service discloses internal information via an observable discrepancy between possible responses. An attacker can leverage this in conjunction with other vulnerabilities to execute arbitrary code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28470.

title: Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Accessory Protocol chacha20_decrypt Integer Underflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability.
desc:
Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Accessory Protocol chacha20_decrypt Integer Underflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Accessory Protocol service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing pairing requests, the process does not properly validate user-supplied data, which can result in an integer underflow before writing to memory. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28332.

title: Philips Hue Bridge hap_pair_setup_handler Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability.
desc:
Philips Hue Bridge hap_pair_setup_handler Heap-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Accessory Protocol service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. When parsing pairing requests, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length, heap-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-28434.

title: Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Pair-Setup Default Password Authentication Bypass Vulnerability.
desc:
Philips Hue Bridge HomeKit Pair-Setup Default Password Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of Philips Hue Bridge. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HomeKit Authentication service, which listens on TCP port 8080 by default. Crafted data in a pairing request can cause the device to allow authentication using a blank password. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-28323.

title: llama.cpp MTMD Multimodal GGUF File Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability.
desc:
llama.cpp MTMD Multimodal GGUF File Parsing Integer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of llama.cpp. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of audio multimodal projector GGUF files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in an integer overflow before allocating a buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-30980.

title: SmarterTools SmarterMail Insufficient Entropy Authentication Bypass Vulnerability.
desc:

title: SmarterTools SmarterMail Missing Authorization Information Disclosure Vulnerability.
desc:

The specific flaw exists within the handling of email attachments. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose sensitive information in the context of a target user. Was ZDI-CAN-33567.

title: SmarterTools SmarterMail File Edit API Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability.
desc:

The specific flaw exists within the FileStorageController class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-30742.

title: SmarterTools SmarterMail Missing Authorization Privilege Escalation Vulnerability.
desc:

The specific flaw exists within the svcDomainAdmin.asmx endpoint. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user. Was ZDI-CAN-33566.

title: ATEN eco DC chartDefine SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability.
desc:
ATEN eco DC chartDefine SQL Injection Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of ATEN eco DC. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of color references when creating charts. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-29124.

title: ATEN eco DC fwDeletes.json Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Deletion Vulnerability.
desc:
ATEN eco DC fwDeletes.json Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Deletion Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to delete arbitrary files on affected installations of ATEN eco DC. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of JSON request data supplied to the fwDeletes.json endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to delete files in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-28621.

title: Hinemos Agent Improper Certificate Validation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability.
desc:
Hinemos Agent Improper Certificate Validation Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Hinemos Agent. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the Hinemos Agent service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the certificate presented by a server. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-28837.

title: open62541 Subscription Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability.
desc:
open62541 Subscription Use-After-Free Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of open62541. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of subscriptions. The issue results from the lack of validating the existence of an object prior to performing operations on the object. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-30231.

title: Missing authorization vulnerability in ASUS Control Center Datacenter and Control Center Enterprise allows remote authenticated users with a low-privileged Viewer role to change…
desc:
Missing authorization vulnerability in ASUS Control Center Datacenter and Control Center Enterprise allows remote authenticated users with a low-privileged Viewer role to change the password of an Administrator account, thereby obtaining administrative privileges, via a crafted password update request. 
Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Control Center  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

title: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP GiveWP give allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects GiveWP: from n/a through 4.19.2.
desc: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Liquid Web / StellarWP GiveWP give allows Retrieve Embedded Sensitive Data.This issue affects GiveWP: from n/a through 4.19.2.

title: Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the access control of Items.
desc: Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the access control of Items. If this vulnerability is exploited, a remote authenticated attacker who can view records in the affected product may obtain the values of Items for which read access is restricted by Column access control. Note that the vulnerability affects configurations where read access conditions are set in Column access control settings.

title: Pleasanter contains an issue with insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the API.
desc: Pleasanter contains an issue with insertion of sensitive information into sent data in the API. If the affected product receives a specially crafted API request sent by a remote authenticated attacker, the authentication credentials of other users, including administrators, such as API keys, may be obtained. As a result, the attacker may perform arbitrary operations on the affected product with the privileges associated with the obtained credentials.

title: Converting crafted input from UCS-4 to IBM1390 or IBM1399 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.3.3 and later may result in the converter reading past the end of the…
desc:
Converting crafted input from UCS-4 to IBM1390 or IBM1399 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.3.3 and later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash.

When converting from UCS-4, these encoders may encounter a combining base such as U+00E6 and jump ahead by 4 bytes to check the next UCS-4 code point.  The check for end of buffer however does not account for this, which may result in a buffer overread if the following code point has less than 4 bytes remaining.  Exploitation of this bug not only requires attacker control of input and encoding, but also strict control over layout of the input in memory.

title: Pleasanter contains an issue with improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('Path Traversal') in the API.
desc: Pleasanter contains an issue with improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('Path Traversal') in the API. If this vulnerability is exploited, an arbitrary file on the server where the product is running may be obtained by a remote authenticated attacker.

title: Converting crafted ISO-2022-CN-EXT input to UTF-8 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.2 through 2.44 may result in the converter reading past the end of the input…
desc:
Converting crafted ISO-2022-CN-EXT input to UTF-8 character encoding, in the GNU C Library version 2.2 through 2.44 may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash.

When the ISO-2022-CN-EXT decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\x0e' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice.  If this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer.  To exploit this, the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

title: Converting crafted CP949 input to UTF-8 character encoding and ignoring invalid characters, in the GNU C Library version 2.1 or later may result in the converter reading past the…
desc:
Converting crafted CP949 input to UTF-8 character encoding and ignoring invalid characters, in the GNU C Library version 2.1 or later may result in the converter reading past the end of the input buffer, causing the calling application to crash.

When the CP949 decoder encounters an invalid input byte sequence like '\xa2\xe8' it ends up advancing the pointer tracking the read buffer position twice.  If //IGNORE is set on the destination encoding and this sequence is at the end of the input buffer, the decoder may then end up reading past the bounds of the input buffer.  To exploit this, the target iconv function needs to set //IGNORE on the destination of the conversion and the input and encoding needs to be attacker controlled.

title: A flaw was found in OpenShift Hive.
desc: A flaw was found in OpenShift Hive. The ClusterClaim controller assigns hive-claim-owner RBAC based on a user-controlled ClusterClaim.spec.namespace and only verifies ClusterPoolRef.ClaimName. A tenant can point a same-named claim at another tenant's ClusterDeployment and obtain get access to that cluster's admin kubeconfig and admin password secrets.

title: Incorrect default permissions in the ASUS DisplayWidget Center allow a local, low-privileged user to achieve arbitrary code execution in the security context of another user via…
desc:
Incorrect default permissions in the ASUS DisplayWidget Center allow a local, low-privileged user to achieve arbitrary code execution in the security context of another user via a crafted executable placed in that user-writable directory, which the application launches when the other user runs it and uses a particular feature.Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS Display Widget Center ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

title: Winmate HotTab Exposed Dangerous Function Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability.
desc:
Winmate HotTab Exposed Dangerous Function Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Winmate devices. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HotTab driver. The issue results from an exposed dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of the kernel. Was ZDI-CAN-29948.

title: Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in Publishing feature.
desc: Pleasanter contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in Publishing feature. If this vulnerability is exploited, a remote unauthenticated attacker who can access a site published using the product may obtain, by sending a specially crafted request, information on records of unpublished sites (e.g., titles), as well as the names of users, groups, and organizations registered in the same tenant. Note that the vulnerability only affects configurations where both of the following conditions are met: a site is published using the Publishing feature, and the published site contains link items (items linked to other sites, users, groups, or organizations).

title: Typecho before 1.3.1-rc contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the XML-RPC pingback.ping method where checkSafeHost() validates a hostname's resolved IP once but…
desc: Typecho before 1.3.1-rc contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability in the XML-RPC pingback.ping method where checkSafeHost() validates a hostname's resolved IP once but the subsequent outbound request performs an independent DNS resolution, creating a TOCTOU window exploitable via DNS rebinding. An unauthenticated attacker can configure a domain to return a benign IP at validation time and an internal address (loopback, RFC1918, or cloud metadata IP) at request time, causing the server to issue blind SSRF requests to arbitrary internal hosts and ports.

title: An SSH certificate authentication bypass vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated organization member to read and modify another user's private…
desc: An SSH certificate authentication bypass vulnerability in GitHub Enterprise Server allowed an authenticated organization member to read and modify another user's private repositories within the trusted certificate authority's scope. Exploitation required an instance using built-in authentication and a valid certificate issued to the attacker by a trusted SSH certificate authority. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

title: A site administrator could modify files on the appliance host with root privileges and disclose private repository data due to improper path validation in GitHub Enterprise Server.
desc: A site administrator could modify files on the appliance host with root privileges and disclose private repository data due to improper path validation in GitHub Enterprise Server. Exploitation required a crafted pre-receive hook environment. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server versions prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

title: A command injection vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated site administrator to execute arbitrary commands as the host git user…
desc: A command injection vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated site administrator to execute arbitrary commands as the host git user on peer Git server nodes outside the pre-receive hook sandbox by supplying a crafted pre-receive environment download URL. Exploitation required a clustered deployment using custom pre-receive hook environments and at least one peer Git server node. This vulnerability affected all versions of GitHub Enterprise Server prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.22.5, 3.21.10, 3.20.12, and 3.19.16. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

desc:

Refer to the '
Security Update for ASUS System Control Interface  ' section on the ASUS Security Advisory for more information.

title: An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed authenticated users to read review-thread data from…
desc: An authorization bypass through user-controlled key vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed authenticated users to read review-thread data from private repositories they could not access. An attacker required an authenticated account, a readable repository and pull request to use as the request context, and target review-thread identifiers. The thread-preview endpoint resolved supplied identifiers without restricting them to the authorized pull request, exposing private file paths and, when positioning and diff data were available, source-code excerpts, commit identifiers, and line metadata without victim interaction. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases in the 3.21, 3.22 series and was fixed in versions 3.21.10, 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

title: An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated user whose numeric user ID matched an enterprise's numeric ID to…
desc: An incorrect authorization vulnerability was identified in GitHub Enterprise Server that allowed an authenticated user whose numeric user ID matched an enterprise's numeric ID to manage that enterprise's GitHub Apps and generate private keys without enterprise membership. GitHub App ownership checks compared numeric IDs without checking the owner's account type. Exploitation required control of a session for the colliding user account and an enterprise-owned GitHub App. A generated private key could be used to authenticate as the App and access repositories where it was installed, within its granted permissions. On standard fresh installations, the documented collision involved the non-loginable built-in ghost account; the reported GHES reproduction used site administrator impersonation. This vulnerability affected supported GitHub Enterprise Server releases prior to 3.23 and was fixed in versions 3.19.16, 3.20.12, 3.21.10, and 3.22.5. This vulnerability was reported via the GitHub Bug Bounty program.

title: A flaw was found in CRI-O.
desc: A flaw was found in CRI-O. When the optional Linux LinkLogs feature is enabled, the host pod log directory is bind-mounted into a pod emptyDir and is intended to be read-only, but Linux ignores MS_RDONLY on the initial bind and the CRI mount stays writable. A non-privileged UID 0 container can place a symlink at a future kubelet log path so that privileged conmon later appends attacker-controlled log data to an existing host file. This is an append-only host integrity issue, not universal remote code execution; LinkLogs is not enabled by default.

title: A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-galaxy role installation.
desc: A path traversal vulnerability (CWE-22) was found in ansible-core's ansible-galaxy role installation. An explicit role "name" taken from a role's meta/requirements.yml is used to construct the on-disk installation path without validating that the resulting destination stays within the selected roles directory. A name containing "../" escapes that directory, and an absolute name replaces it entirely. Because ansible-galaxy processes transitive dependencies from an installed role's meta/requirements.yml, a malicious role publisher can cause attacker-supplied files to be written outside the operator's chosen roles directory when the operator installs the role, and, when --force is used, can cause an existing role directory outside that path to be removed and replaced. The impact is bounded by the invoking user's filesystem permissions and requires the operator to install the attacker-influenced content.

Easily exploitable vulnerability allows high privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Contracts.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of Oracle Contracts. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.2 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

title: Vulnerability in the Oracle Hyperion Financial Data Quality Management, Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Hyperion (component: Security).
desc: Vulnerability in the Oracle Hyperion Financial Data Quality Management, Enterprise Edition product of Oracle Hyperion (component: Security).   The supported version that is affected is 11.2.26.0.000. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with logon to the infrastructure where Oracle Hyperion Financial Data Quality Management, Enterprise Edition executes to compromise Oracle Hyperion Financial Data Quality Management, Enterprise Edition.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Hyperion Financial Data Quality Management, Enterprise Edition accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 5.5 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N).

title: Vulnerability in the Oracle Mobile Field Service product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Admin UI).
desc: Vulnerability in the Oracle Mobile Field Service product of Oracle E-Business Suite (component: Admin UI).  Supported versions that are affected are 12.2.3-12.2.15. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise Oracle Mobile Field Service.  While the vulnerability is in Oracle Mobile Field Service, attacks may significantly impact additional products (scope change).  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized access to critical data or complete access to all Oracle Mobile Field Service accessible data as well as  unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of Oracle Mobile Field Service accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 9.3 (Confidentiality and Integrity impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:L/A:N).
